fcw.ponder.arc_furnace_kit.text_1: The kit needs 8 x 6 x 5 free blocks: width, height, depth
fcw.ponder.arc_furnace_ports.text_1: Charge port on top: quartz, iron, coal, redstone, silicon
fcw.ponder.arc_furnace_ports.text_2: Tap: silicon and steel come out here
fcw.ponder.chain.text_1: Arc furnace: quartz to silicon, iron to steel, silicon to polysilicon
fcw.ponder.chain.text_4: EUV scanner: wafer and reticle to a patterned wafer
fcw.ponder.chain.text_5: Electronics line: patterned wafers to chips, chips and board blanks to boards
fcw.ponder.chain.text_6: Item ports are item handlers: hoppers and pipes can link the machines
fcw.ponder.chip_line_kit.text_1: The kit needs 14 x 3 x 3 free blocks: width, height, depth
fcw.ponder.chip_line_ports.text_1: Wafer port: patterned wafers and the metal for packaging
fcw.ponder.chip_line_ports.text_2: Board port: board blanks and the parts for assembly
fcw.ponder.chip_line_ports.text_3: Board output: finished boards and memory modules
fcw.ponder.chip_line_ports.text_4: Chip tray: packaged chips and processors; the assembly also takes chips from it
fcw.ponder.crystal_puller_kit.text_1: The kit needs 5 x 7 x 4 free blocks: width, height, depth
fcw.ponder.euv_build.text_1: 301 blocks of 23 kinds in a box of 13 x 6 x 5; the layout is in the guide
fcw.ponder.euv_build.text_10: Right-click the controller: a wrong block is named in chat and marked with red dust
fcw.ponder.euv_build.text_11: When every block is in place the blank becomes the machine
fcw.ponder.euv_build.text_12: Breaking a cell while sneaking turns it back into the building blocks
fcw.ponder.euv_build.text_2: Layer 1: wafer handler, wafer stage, vacuum chamber, laser amplifiers; ports in the back row
fcw.ponder.euv_build.text_3: Layer 2: controller in the front row, two FOUP load ports on the wafer end, chillers on the laser end
fcw.ponder.euv_build.text_4: Layer 3: mirrors above the wafer stage
fcw.ponder.euv_build.text_5: Layer 4: the collector inside the vacuum chamber
fcw.ponder.euv_build.text_6: Layer 5: reticle stage and droplet generator
fcw.ponder.euv_build.text_8: Load ports, item hatches and the controller face outwards
fcw.ponder.euv_build.text_9: Back row: data, gas, exhaust, energy and coolant ports, power cabinet
fcw.ponder.euv_scanner_mk2_ports.text_1: Two FOUP docks: wafers go in, patterned wafers come out
fcw.ponder.euv_scanner_mk2_ports.text_2: Reticle port: the photomask stays inside and is not consumed
fcw.ponder.euv_scanner_mk2_ports.text_3: Tin drawer: one more item input, not needed by the current recipes
fcw.ponder.euv_scanner_mk2_ports.text_4: Data port: reserved for control from a computer
fcw.ponder.shared.kit_break: Sneak and break any cell: the kit and the contents drop
fcw.ponder.shared.kit_front: The operator panel faces the player who placed it
fcw.ponder.shared.kit_place: Right-click the ground: the whole machine is placed
fcw.ponder.shared.port_breaker: Main breaker: the machine works only while it is on
fcw.ponder.shared.port_fluids: Fluid ports: accepted, not needed by the current recipes
fcw.ponder.shared.port_panel: Operator panel: status, start and stop
fcw.ponder.tag.production.description: Multiblock machines of the chip production chain
fcw.ponder.wafering_cell_kit.text_1: The kit needs 8 x 3 x 3 free blocks: width, height, depth
